description: Cross-platform pure C++23 Modules networking engine using native stackless coroutines, io_uring with epoll fallback, per-loop HTTP/1.1 and HTTP/2, BoringSSL QUIC/HTTP/3, routed WebSocket upgrades, and native gRPC. One image serves HTTP/1.1, WebSocket and gRPC h2c on :8080, TLS HTTP/1.1 on :8081, h2c on :8082, HTTP/2 on :8443/tcp and HTTP/3 on :8443/udp.
